sources.title: Introduction | Zyrabit Docs
sources.snippet: Zyrabit SLM is a production-grade Small Language Model (SLM) orchestration stack designed for on-premise and private cloud environments. It provides a containerized architecture to deploy, manage, and scale local AI capabilities while maintaining strict data privacy and network isolation.

sources.title: Zyrabit - GitHub
sources.snippet: 🚀 Our Mission We build the infrastructure that enables Regulated Industries (Banking, Gov, Healthcare) to deploy Generative AI without compromising Data Sovereignty. We believe in a future where AI runs efficiently on Edge/On-Premise Hardware (CPU-first), protecting sensitive data through rigorous Zero-Trust Architectures.

sources.title: Zyrabit | Sovereign AI Infrastructure for Regulated Teams
sources.snippet: The AI lives inside. Audit transactions and run private compliance agents directly on local hardware — zero cloud telemetry. Analyze clinical records and draft diagnostics within the hospital network, respecting local health privacy laws.
